profile.headline: Front-End Developer | Shopify & WordPress Expert | React, Next.js, JavaScript | E-Commerce Platforms & Scalable Web Applications
profile.summary:
I’m a front-end developer with a background in business and hands-on experience building and maintaining production web applications, with a strong focus on e-commerce platforms and scalable front-end systems. I specialize in turning design mockups into fast, accessible, and responsive interfaces using modern JavaScript frameworks, while keeping performance, maintainability, and user experience at the center of every build.

Most of my recent work has focused on Shopify and WordPress based e-commerce platforms, where I’ve delivered high-traffic, conversion-focused sites and integrated third-party tools for payments, analytics, and marketing. Alongside client-facing work, I’ve contributed to more complex web applications involving API integrations, data-driven features, and performance optimization. 

I’m actively expanding my skill set beyond traditional front-end development by working with modern frameworks, backend services, and system integrations, with the goal of building reliable, scalable software that supports real business operations. I enjoy collaborating across teams, translating business requirements into technical solutions, and continuously improving how software is built and maintained.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Web Developer at Ryze Agency, I contribute to building visually engaging, responsive websites with a strong focus on user experience and performance. Working primarily with Shopify and WordPress, I collaborate closely with designers and senior developers to bring digital projects to life.

Key Responsibilities & Highlights:

-Assist in developing and maintaining custom websites on WordPress and Shopify, aligning with modern web standards and client goals.

-Convert Figma, Adobe XD, and PSD designs into responsive, pixel-perfect layouts using HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, and Liquid (for Shopify).

-Support the integration of third-party tools such as email platforms, analytics, and CRM systems to extend site functionality.

-Collaborate with design and development teams to implement reusable front-end components and improve site scalability.

-Conduct thorough testing across browsers and devices to ensure consistent user experience and performance.

-Apply performance optimization techniques, improving site speed, accessibility, and SEO metrics.

-Continuously learn and apply best practices in front-end development to keep pace with evolving technologies and frameworks.

projects.title: PicBurst
projects.description: An attempt to replicate the Instagram website using Firebase, including user authentication and authorization. Including the ability to upload images to your feed, like, comment, and save posts to your profile with the help of Firestore.

projects.title: Los Magueyes
projects.description: A collaborative work where I implemented the front-end development in using Typescript and Tailwind CSS, and an experienced full stack developer who assisted on the backend using AWS. We worked on this website for a very satisfied client in New Jersey who wants to spread their business in catering service.
